groups.description: A section's report groups, in the order of their first account's code; none for a measure.

key.description: The block: for the P&L revenue, cost_of_sales, gross_profit, operating_expenses, ebitda, depreciation_amortisation, operating_profit, other_income, finance_and_other, profit_before_tax, income_tax, net_profit; for the balance sheet current_assets, non_current_assets, total_assets, current_liabilities, borrowings, total_liabilities, equity, liabilities_and_equity, equity_movement; for the cash flow operating, net_operating, investing, net_investing, financing, net_financing, net_change, cash_at_start, cash_at_end; for the trial balance asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense and total.

measure.description: true for a line computed from the sections above it.

items.description: A % of revenue to one decimal, such as 12.5; empty for none.
